analyst.summary: JM Financial is a diversified financial-services group (investment banking, wealth management, NBFC lending, home loans). The stock looks statistically cheap at roughly 10-11 times earnings and about book value, but revenue actually declined 6.6% over the last year (versus 8.7% growth over three years), debtor/collection days have lengthened noticeably, and the group settled a SEBI enforcement matter over a 2024 bond-issue irregularity in September 2025. We read the low valuation as a fair reflection of current business softness rather than an opportunity, and rate this a Sell.
